You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0152.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

args.command:
python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
im=Image.open('mol_0152.png');print(im.size); im.crop((520,120,1110,510)).resize((1770,1170)).save('detail.png')
PY

cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
atoms=['C','C','C','C','C','C','C','O','O','C','C','O','C','C','O','C','C','C','C','O','C','O','C','O','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','H','H']
xy=[(365,294),(469,235),(573,294),(573,414),(469,474),(365,414),(263,474),(237,379),(160,510),(65,500),(687,257),(663,149),(786,178),(756,355),(686,458),(817,250),(938,250),(997,355),(938,458),(817,458),(1100,355),(997,149),(1115,149),(1175,45),(1176,250),(1296,250),(1356,355),(1476,355),(1536,458),(1476,562),(1356,562),(1296,458),(573,177),(573,530)]
bonds=[(0,1,1),(1,2,1),(2,3,1),(3,4,1),(4,5,1),(5,0,1),(5,6,1),(6,7,2),(6,8,1),(8,9,1),(2,10,1),(10,11,1),(11,12,1),(10,12,1),(10,13,1),(3,14,1),(14,13,1),(13,15,1),(15,16,1),(16,17,1),(17,18,1),(18,19,1),(13,19,1),(17,20,1),(16,21,1),(21,22,1),(22,23,2),(22,24,1),(24,25,2),(25,26,1),(26,27,2),(27,28,1),(28,29,2),(29,30,1),(30,31,2),(31,26,1),(2,32,1),(3,33,1)]
mol=Chem.RWMol()
for element in atoms: mol.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(element))
for i,j,order in bonds: mol.AddBond(i,j, {1:Chem.BondType.SINGLE,2:Chem.BondType.DOUBLE}[order])
mol=mol.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
conf=Chem.Conformer(len(atoms))
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(xy):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x/100,-y/100,0))
mol.AddConformer(conf)
for i,j,t in [(5,6,'up'),(2,32,'up'),(3,33,'up'),(10,11,'down'),(10,12,'up'),(13,15,'down'),(13,19,'up'),(16,21,'down'),(17,20,'down')]:
  b=mol.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j); b.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE if t=='up' else Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(mol)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mol,force=True,cleanIt=True)
print('stereocenters',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol,includeUnassigned=True,includeCIP=True))
print('tag',[(a.GetIdx(),str(a.GetChiralTag())) for a in mol.GetAtoms() if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED])
print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(mol,isomericSmiles=True))
Chem.MolToMolFile(mol,'drawn.mol')
# Remove conformer + attach hydrogens and sample conformers
mol.RemoveAllConformers()
mol=Chem.AddHs(mol)
ps=AllChem.ETKDGv3();ps.randomSeed=142;ps.numThreads=4;ps.maxIterations=200;ps.useRandomCoords=False
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mol,numConfs=35,params=ps)
print('embedded',len(ids), flush=True)
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mol,numThreads=4,maxIters=500)
for j,(status,energy) in enumerate(res):print(j,status,round(energy,2),flush=True)
best=min(range(len(ids)),key=lambda x:res[x][1]);print('best',best,res[best],flush=True)
conf=mol.GetConformer(best)
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{mol.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D stereochemically defined molecule, MMFF94 optimized\n')
 for atom in mol.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx());f.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}\n')
PY
python build.py

python - <<'PY'
p='build.py'
s=open(p).read();s=s.replace("Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(mol)","alkene=mol.GetBondBetweenAtoms(24,25)\nalkene.SetStereoAtoms(22,26)\nalkene.SetStereo(Chem.BondStereo.STEREOE)\nChem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(mol)")
s=s.replace("print('best',best,res[best],flush=True)","print('best',best,res[best],flush=True)\ncheck=Chem.Mol(mol);Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(check,confId=best,replaceExistingTags=True);print('check 3d',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(check,includeUnassigned=True,includeCIP=True));print('3d SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(check,isomericSmiles=True))")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python build.py
